notes: Fixed a bug where leaving the app while music was playing could kill playback:the self-update engine was deferring an incoming update to the moment you close the app, then applying it immediately on background — reloading the app and cutting the song off. Music now keeps playing when you leave the app,and the install waits for the next clean stop

The update-ready message shows at most once per download,and a downloaded-but-deferred update is offered again right when you start playing a song (Install now / later), so the app can never sneak an update in while music is playing
Top hits in Discover loads again — the chart now goes through the same resilient fetch path as every other chip, so blocked domains and flaky networks can't kill it
Set photo on pinned artists actually shows your picture now — and it sticks across app updates like it always should have
Reordering albums & singles feels like playlist reordering — haptic on pickup, rows slide out of the way, auto-scroll on long drags, smooth snap on drop
Settings → More cleanup: "Ask artist when importing" moved under Playback & sound, and Library Tools is now Library Tools & Fetching
